headline: Wardens' Last Post Falls in Kuura Strand; Nevish Line Seethes
war_summary: Three hours more have redrawn the northern map. Kuura Strand, where the Wardens clung to a single holding at last report, now flies Colonial colors throughout — six bases strong — after thirty-eight flag actions in a day, Faden Point by far the busiest ground. On the Nevish Line the count stands as before, six Warden posts against two Colonial, yet the fighting has not slackened: fifty-seven base actions in twenty-four hours, twelve of them in the past two, and casualties swelling past six thousand eight hundred on each side, with Princefal and Blackcoat Way the most contested points. Weathered Expanse shows fresh movement — the Wardens now hold two posts against three Colonial and four demolished — while Crow's Nest and Shattered Advance take the worst pounding and casualty rates climb by the hour on the war's costliest front. Linn Mercy, quiet at the flags since late morning, has turned bloody again by the casualty rolls about Lathair; Marban Hollow likewise stirs around Checkpoint Bua. Stlican Shelf's lone Warden post at Breaker Town draws fresh fire. Callahans Passage, lately surging, has cooled. Thirty-four victory towns remain the prize; no victor is declared.
